tasks.short: Count materials and finished products and request supplies

steps.what: Count materials and capture item, lot, location, unit and observed quantity
Count finished products and capture product, lot, location, unit and observed quantity
Record checked material counts and resolve stock discrepancies in the inventory register
Record finished-product counts and check differences against existing balances
Assess supply needs and prepare a checked replenishment requisition

tasks.design: Configure direct count entry and discrepancy views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, reusing checked records in a {PROCUREMENT} requisition draft. Physical counting, first capture and decisions on discrepancies and supply needs remain with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper count sheets can be copied again into inventory and requisition screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native inventory forms and requisition defaults reduce duplicate entry and arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying mixed lots, actual quantities and the reason for unexplained differences.
tasks.human_edge: Checking physical stock and recognising material suitability.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated entry while retaining counting and replenishment judgement.

reach.learn: Units, lot identity and stock adjustments

evidence.claim: Direct inventory entry and checked requisition defaults are E1 design assumptions; machine quantity collection does not prove physical stock counts are automated.
MPDV HYDRA X can collect production quantities from controls or manual entry, supporting the distinction between measured output and manually captured facts.

assumptions: Boundary covers operator physical inventory, recording and requisition drafting, excluding purchasing approval, supplier work and delivery.

Operator produces item or product identifier, lot, location, unit and observed quantity during fully retained s1 and s2. Missing labels and uncertain quantities are resolved manually there; no assumed camera count or free discrepancy code exists.

S3 and s4 retain record comparison and discrepancy investigation. Operator captures required date, production requirement and requested quantity in s5's nine remaining hours; defaults do not decide need and no free par-level input is assumed.
Test native inventory and procurement features first. Three incremental hours per 100 baseline hours cover item defaults and form upkeep.

Material count and record actions overlap task 10199 through shared ids. In a role roll-up, assign those actual events and their upkeep to task 10189 once; task 10199 is an alternative task view, not additional savings.
unknowns: Current paper copying, inventory features and frequency of mixed lots
research_questions: How much duplicate entry remains after full first capture and discrepancy resolution?

tasks.short: Select coolants and lubricants and start their flow

steps.what: Select suitable coolants and lubricants for the material, tooling and approved process
Connect or set the selected fluid supply and start and verify flow safely

tasks.design: Keep fluid selection and physical flow initiation with the operator. Approved instructions in {DOCS} remain references; no machine-control retrofit is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Correct selection and flow depend on the actual process and machine condition.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference access does not automate connecting, starting or verifying fluid delivery.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting incompatible fluids, blocked delivery and unsafe conditions.
tasks.altitude: No change to physical work or process authority.

evidence.claim: Retaining fluid selection and flow initiation is an E1 judgement; the digest covers paperwork rather than this physical task.

assumptions: Boundary includes selection, flow initiation and immediate verification, excluding repair and separate process engineering.
Operator checks the material, fluid identity and actual flow during retained steps; no structured suitability flag is assumed.
Existing machine runtime earns no saving; no new software means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Fluids, approved recipes and machine supply arrangements
research_questions: Which abnormal flow conditions require maintenance intervention?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross0 and net0 because selection and physical flow verification remain unchanged.
